data.description:
## Surface
GitHub Actions, repo navapbc/rebar, workflow **Test Suite (mirror)** (scheduled/dispatch, non-blocking mirror tier), matrix `sweep (…)` jobs. The blocking core tiers (`build-and-test / pytest` ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 + macos py3.13, lint+type-check) **pass** on main; only the experimental `sweep` matrix is red.

## Signatures (distinct sub-failures, same red mirror suite)
1. **sweep (windows)** — collection error, many test modules: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fcntl'` (fcntl is Unix-only; imported at import/collection time). Windows tier cannot even collect.
2. **sweep (py3.14)** — `tests/scripts/graph/test_doctor_locks.py::test_a_contended_fcntl_leg_reads_as_held` FAILED: `RuntimeError: Network access is forbidden in unit/scripts tests` (unmocked network call; needs a mock or `@pytest.mark.allow_network`). 1 failed / 18330 passed.
3. Also red in the same run: `sweep (py3.14t)`, `sweep (py3.15)`, `sweep (macos, full suite)`, `sweep (declared lower-bound resolution)` — not individually triaged; likely overlapping causes.

## First/last seen in-window
Recurs every scheduled mirror run in window, e.g. runs 33328948461 (2026-08-30T18:44Z), 33312376473, 33299427686, 33285143350, 33269092028 (2026-08-29T18:44Z).

## Dedup
No existing ticket found (searched "Test Suite mirror sweep py3.14/py3.15 fcntl windows"). New.

## Severity: P3
Mirror/experimental tier — does not block the Gerrit Verified gate or Release, and core supported Pythons are green. CI-hygiene / cross-platform-portability signal only. Assignee may split the Windows-fcntl portability issue from the py3.14 unmocked-network test defect.

## Provenance
Periodic ops-error sweep (window 2026-08-29T10:00 → 2026-08-30T17:36 PDT). Triage only.
data.title: [ci] Test Suite (mirror) sweep tiers red in-window: fcntl ModuleNotFoundError on Windows collection + py3.14 network-forbidden test failure
